events.text_en: Tra Cam Tỉnh ties bitter root to her chest and goes down into the last well of Tình Sa Thôn. The well-drinker spits out its water and leaves the town alive. The well is bitter still.
The wandering talisman master Sách Viễn Thư is found shaven and bloodless on the road; his disciple Mặc Huyết Sinh has a new brush.
A scholar in grey buys a lime-burner's nine-year-old daughter at Hôi Diêu Thôn for a cartload of lime, and walks into the karst with her. Neither is seen in the west again.
A Nam Phố talisman puts its copyist to sleep for three days. The ink-grinder who made it leaves the hall that winter and goes up the karst.
Thính Vũ Lâu offers the soul pedlar of the apricot market a guest seat. He declines the lamp, and the Tower sends him a lamp of another kind as a gift.
